question: What paradox is asserted about one who is wise when acting at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence while in a burning state?
premises: Action is directed to the tip of nectar with the tip of essence.
The one acting is in a burning state.
Even a wise person does this.
inference: Even a wise person, while burning, acts at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence.
uncertainties: Purpose of this action not specified
plain_english: Even a wise person, while burning, acts at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence.
